tools.name: hello
tools.description: Say hello. Answered by this app's adapter.ts without calling the upstream, so it works even when dummyjson.com is unreachable. Use it to confirm a client is connected to the gateway.

tools.name: user_search
tools.description: Search DummyJSON's sample users by a free-text query matched against first name, last name, username and email. With no query it returns every user (about 200). The data is fake and public.

tools.name: user_get
tools.description: Get one sample user by numeric id (1 to about 200).

tools.name: user_create
tools.description: Create a sample user. DummyJSON simulates the write: it returns the new record with an id but stores nothing, so this is safe to call. Only the fields your role may write are accepted; naming any other field rejects the whole call.
